snippet.title: Echoes of Elysium – Official Date Announce Trailer | Early Access December 4
snippet.description:
Prepare your airship, gather your crew, and take to the skies.

Echoes of Elysium is a survival RPG where you 6 friends can build, explore, and fight to survive among the floating isles of a shattered afterworld. Construct your own airship, brave the storms, and uncover ancient secrets buried in the clouds.

Features:
- Co-op up to 6 players
- Build and customize your own airship
- Gather resources, craft, and survive in a vast open sky
- Battle skyborne threats alone or with friends
- Discover the truth behind Elysium's fall

🚀 Launches December 4, 2025 — Wishlist Now on Steam:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2644050/Echoes_of_Elysium/

🚀 Enter to Win A Custom Airship PC Bundle:
👉 https://www.echoes.games/pc-giveaway
